positives.title: read Issue authority
positives.given: Portable Plan mutation requested with operation plan_init and typed target
positives.then: returns bounded snapshot: current raw revision token, observed_raw_digest (SHA-256 of raw body), raw_body string, and control projection map with deterministic role extraction; no mutation; no GitHub leak to Core

positives.title: exact Issue body write with matching raw precondition
positives.given: read observed (revision R1, digest D1) exactly equals authorized precondition (authority_source_revision=R1, authority_observed_raw_digest=D1)
positives.when: mutate(request with candidate_raw_body/digest and matching precondition)
positives.then: single typed GitHub Issue body update attempted; adapter success bool returned; no duplicate writes; stale not injected

positives.title: verify-after-write candidate observed
positives.given: Issue body mutation attempted with candidate digest DC and original DO
positives.then: observed == DC -> classification CANDIDATE_OBSERVED -> adapter returns typed observation for M4-7 to map to VERIFIED_RECOVERED; transport success alone not VERIFIED

positives.title: exact control role resolution count=1
positives.given: Issue comment list contains exactly one comment whose body contains the deterministic marker for each required role (milestone_progress_index, development_notes, defect_register)
positives.then: returns exactly that comment ID + current raw revision + digest as deterministic target; no heuristic

positives.title: update canonical control comment in place
positives.given: canonical role target count==1 with current revision RC and body BC
positives.then: single bounded authorized write to that exact comment ID; no new canonical role comment appended; verify readback proves candidate observed

positives.title: append-only Event Log if M4-6-owned
positives.given: typed append-only operation requires Event Log evidence
positives.then: appends exactly one new Event Log comment with evidence; never edits or deletes historical entries; readback confirms appended body digest

negatives.title: stale Issue body precondition
negatives.given: authorized precondition revision R1+digest D1 but current read returns R2 != R1 or D2 != D1
negatives.then: no external GitHub write invoked; response error_code=STALE_AUTHORITY; FAILED_NO_EFFECT; stale fails closed; no last-write-wins

negatives.title: stale comment precondition
negatives.given: canonical comment current revision/digest differs from authorized precondition
negatives.then: no comment write; STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed; control comment not blindly overwritten

negatives.title: duplicate control role >1
negatives.given: Issue contains two comments both matching canonical role milestone_progress_index
negatives.then: CONTROL_ROLE_DUPLICATE -> CONFLICT fail closed; no write; no latest/newest selection; surfaces for reconciliation

negatives.title: missing required control role
negatives.given: required role defect_register has binding count 0
negatives.when: resolveControlRole(role) or any mutation requiring that projection
negatives.then: CONTROL_ROLE_MISSING fail closed; no mutation; bounded error

negatives.title: authorization drift
negatives.given: principal/authorization_reference requires trusted authorization that is not valid for this typed mutation
negatives.then: authorization mismatch -> UNAUTHORIZED/BLOCKED -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT; no external write; fresh authorization required

negatives.title: same key + changed authorization
negatives.given: idempotency_key K1 previously committed with complete identity I1 (principal P1, auth ref A1, contract C1) now replayed with same key K1 but changed authorization I2 (different principal/auth/contract)
negatives.then: SAME_KEY_DIFFERENT_REQUEST -> CONFLICT; GitHub replay denied; no duplicate semantic effect; not silent overwrite

negatives.title: transport success + readback original
negatives.given: mutate returned adapter_success=True but verify readback returns observed == original DO (no authority effect)
negatives.then: ORIGINAL_OBSERVED -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only with fresh authorization+Subject+raw+new lease; not VERIFIED; transport success alone not VERIFIED

negatives.title: transport success + third-state readback
negatives.given: mutate transport success but verify returns third raw digest DT != DO and != DC (including normalized equality case)
negatives.then: CONFLICT_THIRD -> CONFLICT; needs semantic choice; no heuristic third-state merge or normalized equality => CONFLICT

negatives.title: timeout/unknown result
negatives.given: GitHub request timeout / connection reset / response lost; write may have happened but unavailable; or post-write readback unavailable
negatives.then: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN -> RECONCILING handoff; adapter surfaces typed OUTCOME_UNKNOWN observation; no blind retry; no old lease reuse; no guess

negatives.title: generic GitHub operation
negatives.given: caller attempts gh api <arbitrary path> or generic mutation endpoint or raw GitHub REST/GraphQL passthrough
negatives.then: rejected; GENERIC_GITHUB_API_ALLOWED=no; only typed operations allowed

negatives.title: latest-comment heuristic
negatives.given: duplicate roles exist and caller expects latest comment wins / newest selection
negatives.then: HEURISTIC_LATEST_COMMENT_SELECTION_ALLOWED=no; rejected; must fail closed as duplicate

negatives.title: projection partial failure
negatives.given: Issue body verified candidate observed but one or more control projection updates failed (stale, permission, network)
negatives.when: multi-object ordered write (body then projections then Event Log)
negatives.then: PARTIAL_PROJECTION_FAILURE classified; Issue body effect persists; projections remain inconsistent; handed to M4-7 journal as RECONCILING with per-object observations; no cross-object atomic claim

required_case_coverage: 6 positives + 12 negatives (18 cases) plus unknown/timeout/partial-effect variants; all deterministic via fixture GitHub store; no production Issue #9 mutation
production_write_rule: PRODUCTION_GITHUB_ACCEPTANCE_WRITE_ALLOWED=no; all acceptance uses deterministic fixture/fake transport stub
